name: idle
source: Transcribed from Kirakun0328/text-to-vrma src/idleMotion.js (MIT). No external asset or retargeting required.
units: rotations = degrees [x,y,z] applied to humanoid bone; hips p = metres [x,y,z]; blink w = 0..1 weight
notes: Arm angles assume an A-pose base (arms ~70 deg from T-pose). Adjust if the target VRM rests in a different pose. Chest 2.5 deg + hips -0.008 m give the breathing motion; two blinks per 4 s loop.
